title: How Much Graph Is Too Much? Graph Construction and Exposure in Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.34611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatio-temporal graph neural networks combine a node's history with information from graph neighbors. The central question is whether graph neighbors provide predictive information beyond each node's own history. Forecast accuracy depends on both the choice of neighbors and the way graph messages enter the temporal model. We study these choices as graph construction and graph exposure on U.S. state unemployment, traffic speed, and electricity demand. Our diagnostic design uses two comparisons: varying exposure while holding the domain graph fixed, and varying construction while holding late gated integration fixed. A GRU using only each node's own history and randomized graph controls help assess what the graph contributes. Under a common change forecasting protocol, the same domain graph can improve or worsen error relative to the GRU across integration designs. translated_title: 图到底要用多少才算多？时空预测中的图构建与图暴露
translated_abstract: 时空图神经网络将节点自身的历史信息与来自图邻居的信息相结合。其核心问题是：图邻居能否在节点自身历史之外提供额外的预测信息。预测精度既取决于邻居节点的选择（图构建），也取决于图信息进入时间模型的方式（图暴露）。本文在美国各州失业率、交通速度和电力需求数据上研究了这两种选择。诊断性设计采用两组对比：在固定领域图的前提下改变图暴露方式，以及在固定后置门控融合的前提下改变图构建方式。仅使用节点自身历史的GRU以及随机化图对照，有助于评估图信息带来的贡献。在统一的变化预测协议下，同一领域图在不同的融合设计下，相对于仅用自身历史的GRU，既可能改善误差也可能恶化误差。仅有后置融合是不够的，而加入融合门控则能带来（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文系统解耦了时空预测中“图构建”与“图暴露”两个因素，发现同一领域图在不同融合设计下既可能提升也可能损害预测精度，仅靠后置融合不足以获益，需要引入融合门控才能稳定发挥图信息的作用。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically disentangles graph construction and graph exposure in spatio-temporal forecasting, showing that the same domain graph can either improve or worsen accuracy depending on the integration design, with late integration alone insufficient and a fusion gate needed for consistent gains from graph information.
